cohort: The study included women aged 18 years or older with newly diagnosed and histologically confirmed invasive breast cancer enrolled at six public hospitals in South Africa.
finding: HIV-positive status was associated with an increased proportion of triple-negative breast cancer, particularly among women with chronic HIV infection and those on antiretroviral therapy.
cross-section timing: Data was analysed from patients who enrolled between January 1, 2015, and January 18, 2022.
